title: driver-mongodb: field `unique` is built as a sparse index, so two explicit `null` values collide, unlike the NULL-distinct rule of driver-sql and driver-memory
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #29176 dev (os-dev-report 6575284496, `out_of_scope_findings` class b), read from source, NOT MEASURED (the dev's container could not download `mongod`). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · a driver diverges from the shared unique rule; no grant or disclosure.

Reach: a deployment on `driver-mongodb` with an optional field declared `unique`, when two records hold no value in it.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-schema.ts`).

## What happens (source reading)

- `mongodb-schema.ts` builds a field's `unique` as `{ unique: true, sparse: true }`. A sparse index skips only documents that lack the field; it still indexes an explicit `null`, so two documents storing `null` collide.
- driver-sql's unique index and driver-memory's key model are NULL-distinct (see the `memory-unique-constraint.ts` docblock): two `null` rows never collide.
- PR #29271 (#29176) now stores a cleared optional unique text field as `null`. On Mongo that is no worse than before (two `''` collided too), but it does not get the fix.

## Wanted

Measure on a real `mongod` first (the conformance harness). If confirmed, build the unique index so missing and `null` are both excluded (for example a `partialFilterExpression` on the field's type, or the driver omitting `null` fields on write), and add the case to the driver conformance ledger so all drivers answer it alike.

Dedupe: searched `mongodb sparse unique null`, `mongo unique index null collide`; none. **New.**

Links back: #29176, PR #29271.
